question: How many products in stock?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail_products WHERE stock > 0;

question: Top product by total sold qty
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(s.qty) AS sold FROM retail_products p JOIN retail_sales s ON s.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY sold DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Average price by category
gold_sql: SELECT category, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM retail_products GROUP BY category;

question: Sales for last 7 days
gold_sql: SELECT DATE(sold_at) AS d, SUM(qty * price) AS revenue FROM retail_sales WHERE sold_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY d ORDER BY d;

question: Products without sales
gold_sql: SELECT p.id, p.name FROM retail_products p LEFT JOIN retail_sales s ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE s.id IS NULL;

question: Stock value (sum of stock × price)
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(stock * price) AS stock_value FROM retail_products;
